subject: GreenBank: request for Dedicated/Private network attestations and SIG mapping
messages:
From: Anna Walsh <anna.walsh@greenbank.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis.ortega@greenbank.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T14:12:00Z
Subject: SOC2 intake — Dedicated/Private network diagrams & SIG/CAIQ mapping

Hi Kimberly,

We're finalizing the SOC 2 scoping for our use of Redwood Inference and need a compact set of artifacts to validate the network/isolation claims for Dedicated and Private deployments. Specifically, can you provide the following by EOD Friday (2027-06-04)?

- A high-level network diagram (PDF) showing Dedicated and Private deployment boundaries, control plane vs data plane paths, and tenant egress expectations.
- A short narrative (1 page) describing how the control plane is segmented from customer data paths, and how fallbacks between hosted/dedicated/private are handled.
- A SIG/CAIQ mapping spreadsheet that identifies which controls are covered by the diagrams/controls we can provide (compact mapping is fine).
- Any redacted versions suitable for inclusion in our external evidence package.

We also need to understand whether there are any third-party egress dependencies (cloud peering, CDN, logging endpoints) that we should call out in the scope.

Please cc procurement (Luis) on the final package so we can attach it to our audit tracker.

Thanks,
Anna Walsh
Senior IT Risk Analyst
GreenBank Financial

Subject: Delivering requested artifacts — GreenBank SOC2 pack (redwood)

Anna / Luis — attaching the initial artifact bundle for your SOC2 evidence package. Files below are delivered as redacted (public) and full (private) variants where applicable. If you need alternative formats (Visio source, higher-res images), tell me and we'll push them to a secure transfer.

Summary of attachments delivered:
- redwood_private_topology_v1.pdf (redacted public + appendix for auditors) — shows Dedicated vs Private boundaries, control-plane routes, tenant egress lanes, and failover behavior.
- controlplane-isolation-legend.png — single-sheet legend with control/data plane annotations and sequence of operations during model-routing/fallback.
- SIG-mapping-GreenBank.xlsx — compact per-control mapping (SIG/CAIQ) with pointers back to diagram pages and narrative snippets.

Key clarifications:
- Control plane is logically and network-wise segregated from customer data lanes. Management traffic uses hardened channels terminated in a separate subnetwork; no customer data shares KV caches or model artifact stores.
- Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) are customer-managed for network isolation; we provide the software image and a private control-plane connector. The diagram notes where KMS/HSM handoffs may occur and which artifacts we redact per-customer policy.
- Third-party egress: we use a small set of cloud endpoints for metrics/log aggregation (listed in the attached SIG spreadsheet appendix). These are optional for Private deployments and can be disabled on request.

Drive links and record: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-greenbank-evidence
HubSpot record: HubSpot: deal/GB-2027-RED-87

Next steps suggested by GreenBank audit team: confirm redaction level for public evidence and request the full (non-redacted) appendix under an NDA if needed.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if the auditor wants a walkthrough of the diagrams.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Architect | Redwood Inference
